method.decision: For a new-source follow-up, require at least two additional useful locations across two named generator checkpoints, at most one additional ordinary group in either held bank, and zero additional isolated-background flags. This replay cannot establish generalization to production recordings.
method.features: Mean and 20th/80th response percentiles inside the proposed range, mean minus available near flanks and outside median, difference between the half-range means, and speech occupancy. No absolute position, source identity or known mix level enters the head.
method.fit: Fit clip-balanced ridge regression with penalty 0.1, an unpenalized intercept and scale floor 0.001. The clock head learns known overlap as IoU if the candidate covers at least half the edit, else zero. The paired head adds a unit-weight loss on feature differences between each edited range and the identical clock of its matched ordinary splices. Fit uses only the 40 separate development recordings from the isolation diagnostic.
method.held: Verify both previously exposed held PCM banks. Reuse exact serving two-second scores on randomized stock clips. Rerun the five-window serving response on the 52 clips with three generators because their saved earlier comparator used only two windows. Report added and standalone useful locations, misses, wrong ranges, assessment, ordinary false flags and isolated backgrounds. A useful location covers half the edit and reaches 0.30 IoU.
method.input: Six seconds of continuous 16 kHz mono PCM. Two original four-second contexts start at zero and two seconds. Align native affine frame responses at 280 + 320i samples from each context origin. Drop the 200 ms nearest an internal context boundary, then average duplicate frame centers. Check 800 ms ranges every 200 ms with at least half detected speech.
method.point: Use 44 severe-noise or isolated recordings from the first stock-voice test. Preserve current flags. Set the strict candidate point at the larger of the second-highest unflagged genuine group maximum and the highest unflagged isolated background response. Fit and seal points before computing held features.
